brief_summary: Three-row comparison ladder under the H2 'The V2 revision: where the feel actually changed'. Each row plots actuation weight (open circle) and bottom-out weight (filled diamond) on a 0-60g+ axis for Ink V2 Yellow, G Pro 3.0 Yellow, and Oil King, with a housing-recipe icon pair (PC/PC solid squares vs PC/nylon solid+hatched squares) and release year at the right margin.
